A.text: An ammonium ion is basic due to a lone pair of electrons on the nitrogen atom.

B.text: Nitrogen monoxide, $\text{NO}$, reacts with peroxyacetyl nitrate to produce a component of photochemical smog.

C.text: Nitrogen dioxide catalyses the oxidation of atmospheric sulfur dioxide.

D.text: Nitrogen is very unreactive due to the very strong permanent dipole–permanent dipole attractions between the nitrogen atoms.
